source_text.body:
Book CRM jobs from a Google Sheet of new customers
A commenter had Grok Bot watch a Google Sheet updated by a Claude agent and log into their CRM to book jobs for new customers; another had it create and post YouTube content.
·
Nov 4, 2026
Done with
GB
Grok Bot
CL
Claude
What they did
One commenter described a handoff between agents: a Claude agent updated a Google Sheet of accepted quotes, and Grok Bot monitored that sheet for new customers. When it detected one, Grok Bot logged into the company’s CRM, booked the jobs, flagged scheduling conflicts, and then asked the user questions to resolve those conflicts.
How it went
They said it worked well and was accurate enough to run continuously for a week. The only limitation mentioned was that conflicts still needed the user’s input to resolve.
Worth knowing
The clearest practical detail is that they let it run for a week straight, with human intervention only when Grok Bot surfaced booking conflicts.
Try it yourself
with
Grok Bot
Copy prompt
Watch this Google Sheet: [link]. When a new customer row appears, log into our CRM at [CRM name] and book a job for them using the details in the row: [which columns hold name, address, service and preferred time]. Mark the row as booked once you are done. Before the first booking, and before any booking that has missing or odd data, pause and show me what you are about to enter so I can approve it.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/GrokBot/comments/1xlq0a4/whats_your_best_grok_bot_use_case_this_week
